tools.name: arc_lending_rates
tools.description: What USDC and EURC earn and cost to borrow on Arc (chain 5042), every market on Aave v4 and Morpho, read from the contracts rather than an index. Includes utilisation and the size of each pool. Paid per call.

tools.name: arc_best_yield
tools.description: Where a specific amount of USDC earns the most on Arc once the deposit's own effect on the pool is counted. A quoted rate is what a pool pays as it stands, and a high rate in a small pool collapses when real size lands in it; this ranks every market by the rate after your deposit. Call this before moving treasury. Paid per call.

size.description: How much USDC, in dollars, for example 100000.

tools.name: gateway_activity_arc
tools.description: Circle Gateway activity on Arc measured at the contract: spends, deposits and batch settlements, where the money went, and how much of it is one address. Free.
